title: W3C Media Working Group-relevant MDN issues
description: Issue filed on MDN Web Docs related to pages attached to technologies developed by W3C Media Working Group

items.content_html:
MDN URL

https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/MediaSession

What specific section or headline is this issue about?

Examples: Setting up action for a music handler

What information was incorrect, unhelpful, or incomplete?

A) '// pause out audio' --> '// pause our audio'

B) There are two lines (four, if you include the comment) that I found incomprehensible. Here is one:

     updateStatus(allMeta[index], "Action: play  |  Track is playing…");

Codewise, 'updateStatus', 'allMeta' and 'index' are all undefined. Furthermore there are no mentions of those words anywhere else on the page. I assume they had been defined in the past and the relevant code was removed.

What did you expect to see?

The three undefined variables should be fulsomely explained, with relevant lines of code, - or -
The two offending lines (plus comments) should be removed from the page.

The example makes sense without those lines although the example would be enriched if the updateStatus function was explained.

Do you have any supporting links, references, or citations?

No response

Do you have anything more you want to share?

You guys do excellent work. Thank you.

As it happens, I am curious about the "updateStatus" function if it changes the user-visible display. I will try to figure it out on my own.
